description: Source code for a standalone WebSocket server implementation, including server setup, TLS support, request handling, and command-line configuration.

classes.name: _StandaloneConnection
classes.description: Mimics mod_python mp_conn, providing address and I/O methods.

classes.name: _StandaloneRequest
classes.description: Mimics mod_python request, providing request details and TLS info.

classes.name: _StandaloneSSLConnection
classes.description: Wraps OpenSSL.SSL.Connection to add makefile, shutdown, and recv handling.

classes.name: WebSocketServer
classes.description: Custom HTTPServer supporting WebSocket, TLS, threading, and socket management.

classes.name: WebSocketRequestHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests, performs WebSocket handshake, and manages CGI paths.

classes.name: ThreadMonitor
classes.description: Thread that periodically logs active server threads for debugging.

methods.description: Creates and returns an OptionParser for command-line arguments.
